question: Should punctuation-attached trailing `NO_REPLY` text become a new control-token syntax, or should this PR preserve the current whitespace-only boundary?
rationale: The existing implementation preserves punctuation-attached text, while this PR intentionally changes that shared user-visible grammar; the maintainer label requires an explicit choice before widening the contract.

options.title: Preserve whitespace-only trailing tokens
options.body: Remove the punctuation lookbehind and its strip expectations, keeping the newline-leading fix without changing existing visible-text semantics.

options.title: Adopt punctuation-attached control tokens
options.body: Keep the new grammar only with explicit maintainer acceptance of the compatibility change and evidence that ordinary punctuation-attached literals are not a supported use case.

recommendation.title: Preserve whitespace-only trailing tokens
recommendation.body: Remove the punctuation lookbehind and its strip expectations, keeping the newline-leading fix without changing existing visible-text semantics.
